Question 1

Which expression gives all of the zeros of y=3sin⁡(2x+π2)? Assume that n is an integer.

a
 x=−π4+nπ2
b
 x=−π4+nπ4
c
 x=−π2+nπ2
d
 x=−π8+nπ4
e
 x=−π2+nπ4
